established: The active selected-device global counter exceeded the exact authorized 16,977,405,952-byte ceiling, and the supervisor failed closed.

The replacement stopped during the train worker before a complete train role result, the planned inter-role process exit/release barrier, the evaluation worker, the metadata join, and the scientific recurrent route.

Under the replacement execution conditions, the prior observation that the 32-scene train half could complete below the same ceiling did not reproduce: only two complete train scene units persisted before this breach.
not_established: The breach does not establish whether the planned process exit between complete train and evaluation roles would have released retained Genesis/Vulkan memory, because that boundary was never reached.

The breach does not by itself identify process-lifetime geometry retention as the cause. The monitor is device-global rather than process-attributed, so an external transient cannot be excluded; early-scene peak demand, within-worker retention, runtime/resource-state differences, or another infrastructure mechanism also remain possible.

The near-return from the pre-run 2,302,283,776-byte baseline to 2,328,842,240 bytes after process exit is consistent with most attempt-associated allocation being released, but it does not attribute the peak or prove a particular leak mechanism.

The breach says nothing about recurrent-DINO representation quality, action conditioning, generalization, planning usefulness, preregistered thresholds, or whether any scientific gate would pass or fail.
diagnostic_interpretation.revision_to_prior_diagnosis: The simple cross-role cumulative-retention diagnosis is no longer sufficient as an explanation of the observed failures. This attempt failed before the intended train/eval process boundary, so the split replacement did not test its proposed release remedy and supplies no causal confirmation of that remedy.

findings.finding: The active selected-device global peak reached 17,259,581,440 bytes against the exact authorized 16,977,405,952-byte ceiling, an excess of 282,175,488 bytes. The supervisor failed closed with BoundedBranchSupervisionError.

The replacement persisted two complete train scene units and no role result before failing during the reported third train scene build. It never reached the train-worker completion, inter-role process exit, release barrier, evaluation worker, or join, so it neither validates nor falsifies the intended inter-role release remedy.

No role result, physics_result.json, checkpoint.pt, result.json, scientific metric, recurrent-model fit, evaluation access, gate, or scientific verdict exists. Partial file counts are infrastructure metadata only.

The exact preregistration, authority, reservations, and terminal prohibit retry, resume, overwrite, refill, and partial reuse. This review does not authorize a successor, further replacement, source edit, handoff edit, model execution, or generated-payload access.

limitations: This review did not open or validate the content of any partial state receipt, live-render receipt, RGB artifact, exact-plan payload, scene-panel payload, checkpoint, or result; it counted only regular-file names and sizes under the generated scene root.
